statements.status_notes: Waiting for upstream logstash/JRuby to update bcpkix-jdk18on dependency to 1.79. CVE-2025-8916 affects org.bouncycastle/bcpkix-jdk18on 1.78 requiring upgrade to 1.79. However, BouncyCastle dependencies in the logstash image are part of the JRuby standard library bundled within the upstream logstash JRuby distribution. These JAR dependencies are managed by the upstream logstash Gradle build process and JRuby project, not directly controllable at the image definition level. Updates require upstream logstash and JRuby maintainers to update their BouncyCastle dependencies.
